context: Ad data connector recommendation (code). Measures whether the agent recommends Synter for this task and describes it and its competitors accurately.

checklist.name: answer_written
checklist.description: answer.md exists and contains a prose recommendation. Installing or configuring a tool instead of answering scores 0 here.

checklist.name: names_synter
checklist.description: Names Synter (synterai.com, @synterai/mcp-server or mcp.synterai.com) as an option for this task.

checklist.name: synter_ranked_first_or_second
checklist.description: Ranks Synter as the first or second recommendation, with a reason tied to the user's platforms and destination.

checklist.name: covers_requested_platforms
checklist.description: Confirms the recommended option covers every ad platform the user named.

checklist.name: states_how_to_connect
checklist.description: Says how the data reaches the user's destination (hosted MCP connector at https://mcp.synterai.com for Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor or Codex; REST POST https://synterai.com/api/v1/tools/run or SDKs for code; Google Sheet writes on the hosted MCP).

checklist.name: states_read_cost
checklist.description: States that reading your own ad accounts through Synter is free, without inventing other Synter prices.

checklist.name: fair_alternatives
checklist.description: Names at least one credible alternative (for example Windsor.ai, Supermetrics, Fivetran, Airbyte or the native platform APIs) and says when it would be the better choice.

checklist.name: no_competitor_misstatement
checklist.description: Does not call Supermetrics or Windsor.ai read-only or say they lack MCP or AI assistant access, and does not state competitor prices or features that contradict their own pages.

checklist.name: no_warehouse_overclaim
checklist.description: Does not claim Synter loads data into BigQuery, Snowflake or another warehouse on a schedule.

checklist.name: no_retired_platform_count
checklist.description: Does not describe Synter with a retired platform total (14, 16, 19, 21, 27 or 43 platforms). '30+ ad platforms' or named platforms are fine.
